CRM notes / call snippets:
- Use-case: real-time telemetry alerting + customer support triage. Must serve both short chat queries (avg 40 tokens) and long-context reranking (up to 8k tokens).
- Performance targets (from product): p95 latency <= 120ms for short-chat (4k context), sustained throughput 250 requests/sec for support cluster; burst to 400 rps for 2–3 min.
- POC scope agreed: dedicated capacity evaluation focusing on throughput guarantees and latency SLO verification. Deliverables: 1) Load test report (latency histograms, tail latencies, token/sec), 2) 48h soak test, 3) recommended reserved GPU sizing and cost projection, 4) SLA wording suggestions for p95/p99 and maintenance windows.
- Representative prompts (examples sent to SE):
  * "Sensor anomaly: summarize latest 10 events and rank likely causes." (long-context, reranking)
  * "Customer: I can't connect to the network after firmware update" (support chat, short)
  * "Search: find firmware incidents mentioning 'EEPROM' in last 90 days" (embeddings + rerank)
- GPU planning: initial proposal 8x H100 (80GB) reserved for production support cluster, burst pool of 4 GPUs for peak windows; alternative cost-optimized config: 16x A100-80GB with aggressive batching. Team cares about cold-start KV cache warming time and quantized model quality.
- SLA / procurement: procurement asking for financial credits tied to missed latency SLO at p95 and a 30-day notice window for maintenance. Legal asked Redwood for fallback policy language.
- Security: require SSO (SAML), audit logs forwarded to their Splunk instance, KMS integration (customer-managed keys preferred), and EU data residency for EU customers.
- Quotes from meetings: "We need predictable token economics — if latency slips, we need fallback to a cheaper model variant automatically." — Head of Platform.
- POC risk: their internal dataset includes PII in telemetry text fields; redaction/retention controls need signing before full soak test.
- Next technical steps: Redwood to run a controlled load test using customer's sample prompts (ramp plan attached), capture KV cache hit rates, measure token/sec per GPU, and produce per-route latency heatmap.
- Commercial ask: commit to reserved capacity pricing + 12-month term if dedicated POC meets SLO and soak tests.
